QuestInfo.name: The New Commander
QuestInfo.0: There's a new Commander. Even the Demons are back. Who could it be?!
QuestInfo.1: You haven't a clue who the Black Mage's new Commander might be. Time to ask #b#p2151009##k.
QuestInfo.2: Even with #b#p2151009#'s#k help, you can't figure out who the new Commander is. Time to investigate!

0.0: If only I knew who the new Commander was. Who do I know that has the qualifications to be a new Commander?

yes.0: I've been asleep for centuries. Everyone I used to know is gone. I should ask #b#p2151009##k.

no.0: No, I will figure it out on my own. I must know someone who fits the bill...
